title: Nixy's Legacy4J Crafting Mod Support
description: Legacy console crafting menu mod support for the Legacy4J mod. Includes Aether, Twilight Forest, Comforts, Waystones, Small Ships, Immersive Aircraft, Scholar, Backpacked by MrCrayfish, Neapolitan, and more. (See description for full list)
body:
This was made alongside an unfinished LCE modpack that I may finish one day.

These are for the survival crafting GUI only as work has not been done for the creative GUI yet.

NOTE: Don't download two or more seperate resource packs adding modded recipes to try and "stack" them together, it will not work.

Current added recipes are:

Aether, Twilight Forest, Comforts, Waystones, Hang Gliders, Small Ships, Immersive Aircraft, Pure S'mores, Printing Press, Scholar, Disenchanting Table by Lupin, Gravestones by Henkelmax, More Chest Variants, Name Tag Tweaks by Serilum (Name Tag Recipe), Backpacked by MrCrayfish, Solar Cooker, Neapolitan

Planned:

Alex's Mobs, Alex's Caves, Alex's Herps, Deep Aether, Aether Redux, Aether Lost Content, Supplementaries, Ammendments, MrCrayfish's Furniture Mod 2.0, Terraquous, Bauble Mounts, Queen Bee, AstikorCarts, [Let's Do] Beach Party, More Crafting Table Variants, More Bookshelf Variants, Item Display, Neapolitan Addons

This has not been tested beyond 1.20.1, but since it's pretty lightweight it *should* work.

Credits to [Psychoshay1](https://modrinth.com/user/psychoshay1) for the Aether and Twilight Forest recipes.

If you are making a crafting GUI support resource pack and see some mods you want to add, feel free to add these to it (with credit please ^^).

If you would like to inquire about collaborations, my discord is nixy.nebula :)
